Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed on a monthly bases 
as indicated by M1 in the title block.
Generators (for units 1, 2): 
type THDI 93/43, 187.5 MVA,150 MW, 10.3kA, 10.5kV, 50Hz, 0.8 PF
Generators (for units 3, 4): 
type THDD 108/53, 387.5MVA,300MW, 10.7kA, 21kV, 50Hz, 0.8 PF

 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Safety and healthy equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet ... etc.
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Safety and healthy equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet ... etc.
No smoking beside the generator is filled by 
 hydrogen gas.
Never remove more than one brush from exciter 
 (ground fault detection system).
The unit in service.
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment.
Measuring 
 rod.
Cleaning 
 fluid and clothes.
Work to be Carried Out
Change over seal oil pumps 1 and 2.
Perform functional check of standby seal oil pump.
Change over vapor exhausters 1 and 2.
Check intake strainer in take port of vacuum pump.
Check exhaust filter at vacuum pump.
Check that 
 regressing device is packed with sufficient grease.
